bio: Hi! I'm Jess (she/her), a Georgian gal still getting used to Cambridge weather. I graduated from the University of Georgia in 2021 with a BS in Astrophysics before coming to Harvard to pursue a PhD in Planetary Science. On an average day, you can catch me listening to music/podcasts, walking my dog, Walter (big fan of attention), and laughing at my own jokes. Congratulations on your acceptance, I'm so excited to welcome you to the community and help you make the most of your first year at Harvard! Community Yards Oak Yard Area Proctors Role Proctors
